correctness.rationale: For each n>=1 and a continuous positive-semidefinite circle cosine series with nonnegative absolutely summable coefficients, the degree-n standard Bernstein image has nonnegative cosine coefficients by the cited preservation theorem. Twice integrating by parts gives the 4n/pi^2*k^-2 parity tails, with endpoint derivatives; zero parity sum forces that parity to vanish identically. Positive tails within a parity and a finite Vandermonde system in e^{2 i theta} determine all nullspaces: two channels give full rank; one channel leaves antipodal pair differences or sums with the asserted constant-channel restriction; no channels give a constant rank-one or zero matrix. n=1 and N=1 boundaries are covered. Direct four-site sign-basis diagonalization yields the four stated eigenvalues and strict unique orthogonal-pair condition optimum. The inspected CHECK.py corroborates finite cases; the infinite proof is analytic. Critical premise is the existing positivity theorem, not finite tests.
